rule: Use smooth scrolling for anchor links
do_pattern: Add scroll-behavior to html element

rule: Implement sticky navigation for long pages
do_pattern: Use position sticky on nav element

dont_code: nav { position: fixed; top: 0; } /* no body padding-top */

rule: Provide breadcrumb trails for deep hierarchies
do_pattern: Use nav with aria-label and ordered list
dont_pattern: Use plain divs with no semantic meaning or ARIA

rule: Use accessible mobile hamburger menus
do_pattern: Toggle aria-expanded on menu button
dont_pattern: Use a div with no keyboard or screen reader support

rule: Manage focus after navigation changes

dont_pattern: Leave focus on the clicked link after page content changes

rule: Add skip links for keyboard users
do_pattern: Provide a skip link as the first focusable element
dont_pattern: Omit skip links forcing tab through entire nav

rule: Show active/current page state in navigation
do_pattern: Use aria-current for the active page link
dont_pattern: Rely only on visual color with no ARIA state

rule: Ensure hamburger icon is recognizable
do_pattern: Use a labeled button with a recognizable icon
dont_pattern: Use an ambiguous custom icon with no label

rule: Organize mega menus with clear groupings
do_pattern: Group links under headings inside the mega menu
dont_pattern: Dump all links in a flat unsorted list

rule: Use proper pagination with accessible controls
do_pattern: Wrap pagination in nav with aria-label
dont_pattern: Use plain spans with click handlers and no roles

rule: Handle infinite scroll with keyboard fallback
do_pattern: Provide a Load More button alongside auto-load
dont_pattern: Auto-load content with no manual trigger or focus control

rule: Preserve back button behavior in SPAs
do_pattern: Use history.pushState for SPA navigation
dont_pattern: Replace history entries breaking the back button

rule: Support deep linking to page sections
do_pattern: Use defined IDs that match URL hash fragments
dont_pattern: Use dynamically generated IDs that change across loads

rule: Enable full keyboard tab navigation
do_pattern: Ensure interactive elements are natively focusable
dont_pattern: Use non-focusable elements for interactive actions

rule: Build accessible dropdown menus
do_pattern: Use aria-haspopup and aria-expanded on trigger
dont_pattern: Show dropdown only on hover with no keyboard support

rule: Make search easily discoverable
do_pattern: Provide a visible search input or toggle button
dont_pattern: Hide search behind an unlabeled icon only

rule: Create helpful 404 pages with navigation options
do_pattern: Offer search and links back to key pages
dont_pattern: Show a dead-end error with no way to navigate

rule: Show loading states during navigation
do_pattern: Display a progress bar or skeleton during load
dont_pattern: Show a blank white screen while content loads

rule: Use progress indicators for multi-step flows
do_pattern: Show current step and total steps clearly
dont_pattern: Give no indication of progress in a multi-step process

rule: Ensure anchor links scroll to visible area
do_pattern: Offset scroll target to account for sticky headers
dont_pattern: Scroll behind sticky headers hiding the target content

rule: Respect prefers-reduced-motion user setting
do_pattern: Disable or reduce animations when user prefers
dont_pattern: Ignore user motion preferences entirely

rule: Keep UI animation durations under 400ms
do_pattern: Use 200-300ms for interface transitions
dont_pattern: Use slow animations that delay user interaction

rule: Use appropriate easing functions
do_pattern: Apply ease-out for entrances and ease-in for exits
dont_pattern: Use linear easing which feels mechanical and unnatural

rule: Animate only transform and opacity for performance
do_pattern: Stick to GPU-friendly compositing properties
dont_pattern: Animate layout properties causing reflows

rule: Avoid large-scale motion that causes motion sickness
do_pattern: Use subtle fades and small translations
dont_pattern: Use large sweeping rotations and zooms

rule: Show meaningful loading animations
do_pattern: Use a spinner with accessible status text
dont_pattern: Use a spinner with no accessible status information

rule: Use consistent transition timing across the UI
do_pattern: Define shared CSS custom properties for duration
dont_pattern: Use random inconsistent durations throughout the app

rule: Stagger animation delays intentionally
do_pattern: Add incremental delays for sequential reveals
dont_pattern: Apply long random delays that confuse users

rule: Optimize keyframes to minimum necessary steps
do_pattern: Use from/to or minimal percentage stops
dont_pattern: Define many unnecessary keyframe stops
dont_code: @keyframes fadeIn { 0% { opacity: 0; } 25% { opacity: 0.25; } 50% { opacity: 0.5; } 75% { opacity: 0.75; } 100% { opacity: 1; } }

rule: Use will-change sparingly and remove after animation
do_pattern: Apply will-change just before animating
dont_pattern: Apply will-change to many elements permanently

rule: Leverage GPU acceleration with translateZ hack only when needed
do_pattern: Use transform: translateZ(0) on animated elements only
dont_pattern: Force GPU layers on all elements wasting memory

rule: Allow users to cancel or skip animations
do_pattern: Provide a way to skip long intro animations
dont_pattern: Force users to watch unskippable animations
dont_code: /* 5 second intro with no skip option */

rule: Keep hover effects subtle and purposeful
do_pattern: Use gentle color shifts or underlines on hover
dont_pattern: Use aggressive pulsing or bouncing on hover

rule: Use scroll animations with Intersection Observer
do_pattern: Trigger animations when elements enter viewport
dont_pattern: Use scroll event listeners causing jank

rule: Limit parallax effects and offer opt-out
do_pattern: Use subtle parallax only on non-essential decorations
dont_pattern: Apply intense parallax to primary content areas

rule: Design micro-interactions that provide feedback
do_pattern: Animate buttons on press to confirm interaction
dont_pattern: Use no feedback leaving users unsure if they clicked

rule: Use skeleton screens instead of blank loading states
do_pattern: Show content placeholders matching layout shape
do_code: .skeleton { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #eee 25%, #ddd 50%, #eee 75%); background-size: 200%; animation: shimmer 1.5s infinite; }
dont_pattern: Show an empty page until all data loads

rule: Fade elements in rather than popping them
do_pattern: Transition opacity from 0 to 1 on appear
dont_pattern: Instantly render elements with display toggle

rule: Use slide transitions for lateral navigation
do_pattern: Slide panels left/right for related content
dont_pattern: Abruptly replace content with no transition

rule: Apply scale animations subtly on interactive elements
do_pattern: Use small scale changes for emphasis on focus
dont_pattern: Use exaggerated scale that distorts layout

rule: Always use visible labels above or beside inputs
do_pattern: Associate labels with inputs using for/id
dont_pattern: Use placeholder text as the only label

rule: Place error messages directly below the invalid field
do_pattern: Show inline error with aria-describedby linkage
dont_pattern: Show all errors in a banner far from the fields
dont_code: Email is required. Name is required.

rule: Validate fields inline on blur not just on submit
do_pattern: Validate when the user leaves the field
dont_pattern: Only validate on form submit surprising the user

rule: Set autocomplete attributes on common fields
do_pattern: Help browsers autofill user data correctly
dont_pattern: Omit autocomplete blocking browser autofill

rule: Use correct input types for data
do_pattern: Use type=email for emails and type=tel for phones
dont_pattern: Use type=text for all fields losing mobile keyboard benefits

rule: Clearly mark required fields
do_pattern: Use aria-required and a visual indicator
dont_pattern: Give no indication of which fields are required

rule: Provide a password visibility toggle
do_pattern: Add a toggle button inside the password field
dont_pattern: Offer no way to verify typed password

rule: Give clear feedback after form submission
do_pattern: Show a success message and next steps
do_code: Form submitted! We will email you shortly.
dont_pattern: Silently submit with no user feedback

rule: Style disabled fields to look non-interactive
do_pattern: Reduce opacity and change cursor on disabled
dont_pattern: Disable fields with no visual distinction

rule: Never use placeholder as a replacement for labels
do_pattern: Use placeholders only for supplementary hints
dont_pattern: Rely on placeholder which vanishes on focus

rule: Group related fields with fieldset and legend
do_pattern: Wrap related inputs semantically
dont_pattern: Use divs with headings but no semantic grouping

rule: Provide help text for complex fields
do_pattern: Add descriptive text linked with aria-describedby
dont_pattern: Expect users to guess the expected format

rule: Add character counters for length-limited fields
do_pattern: Show remaining characters below textarea
dont_pattern: Silently truncate input at max length

rule: Break long forms into logical multi-step wizards
do_pattern: Use a stepped form with progress indication
dont_pattern: Present 20+ fields on a single overwhelming page

rule: Use autofocus only on primary single-purpose pages
do_pattern: Set autofocus on the search input of a search page
dont_pattern: Autofocus on forms within complex pages disrupting scroll
dont_code: <input autofocus /> <!-- on a long dashboard page -->

rule: Use input masking for formatted data
do_pattern: Guide users with a mask pattern for phone numbers
dont_pattern: Accept any format and try to parse it later

rule: Provide clear buttons for search and filter inputs
do_pattern: Add a visible clear/reset button
dont_pattern: Force users to manually select and delete text

rule: Avoid full form reset buttons near submit
do_pattern: Omit reset buttons or place them far from submit
dont_pattern: Place reset next to submit risking accidental data loss

rule: Show inline success messages after submission
do_pattern: Display a success alert with role=status
do_code: Your changes have been saved.
dont_pattern: Redirect silently with no confirmation message

rule: Match input widths to expected content length
do_pattern: Size inputs to hint at expected data length
dont_pattern: Use full-width inputs for short data like zip codes

rule: Meet WCAG contrast ratio of 4.5:1 for normal text
do_pattern: Use dark text on light backgrounds meeting 4.5:1
dont_pattern: Use low-contrast text that fails WCAG AA

rule: Add ARIA labels to icon-only buttons
do_pattern: Provide aria-label describing the action
dont_pattern: Use icon buttons with no accessible name

rule: Use semantic HTML elements over generic divs
do_pattern: Use nav, main, article, section, aside, header, footer
dont_pattern: Build everything with divs and spans

rule: Ensure all functionality is keyboard accessible
do_pattern: Handle both click and keyboard events
dont_pattern: Attach events only to mouse interactions

rule: Provide visible focus indicators on interactive elements
do_pattern: Use a clear custom outline on focus
dont_pattern: Remove focus outlines with no replacement

rule: Write meaningful alt text for informative images
do_pattern: Describe the image content and purpose
dont_pattern: Use empty or generic alt text on informative images

rule: Maintain proper heading hierarchy without skipping levels
do_pattern: Use h1 then h2 then h3 in logical order
dont_pattern: Skip heading levels breaking document outline

rule: Include skip navigation as the first focusable element
do_pattern: Visually hide skip link that appears on focus
dont_pattern: Provide no skip navigation mechanism
dont_code: <!-- no skip link in the page -->

rule: Use sr-only class for screen-reader-only text
do_pattern: Hide visually but keep in accessibility tree
do_code: .sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); }
dont_pattern: Use display:none which hides from screen readers too

rule: Never use color as the sole indicator of state
do_pattern: Combine color with icons or text for status
dont_pattern: Use only red color to indicate errors

rule: Ensure touch targets are at least 44x44 CSS pixels
do_pattern: Set minimum dimensions on interactive elements
dont_pattern: Use tiny tap targets on mobile

rule: Explicitly associate labels with form controls
do_pattern: Use htmlFor matching the input id
dont_pattern: Use implicit or missing label associations

rule: Write descriptive link text that makes sense alone
do_pattern: Describe the destination in the link text
dont_pattern: Use vague generic link text

rule: Set the lang attribute on the html element
do_pattern: Declare the primary language of the page
dont_pattern: Omit the lang attribute entirely

rule: Use ARIA landmark roles to identify page regions
do_pattern: Define banner, navigation, main, and contentinfo
dont_pattern: Use no landmark roles or semantic structure

rule: Use aria-live regions for dynamic content updates
do_pattern: Announce updates to screen readers
dont_pattern: Update content silently with no live announcement

rule: Use buttons for actions and links for navigation
do_pattern: Choose the correct element by purpose
dont_pattern: Use links styled as buttons for actions

rule: Use aria-disabled instead of disabled when focusability is needed
do_pattern: Keep element focusable while marking as inactive
dont_pattern: Use disabled attribute removing element from tab order

rule: Trap focus inside open modal dialogs
do_pattern: Cycle focus within modal boundaries
dont_pattern: Allow focus to escape behind the open modal

rule: Maintain a logical tab order matching visual layout

do_code: <!-- DOM order matches visual left-to-right, top-to-bottom -->

rule: Lazy load images below the fold
do_pattern: Use native loading=lazy on offscreen images
dont_pattern: Load all images eagerly on page load

rule: Serve responsive images with srcset
do_pattern: Provide multiple resolutions for different viewports
dont_pattern: Serve a single large image to all devices

rule: Use modern image formats like WebP with fallback
do_pattern: Serve WebP with a JPEG fallback using picture
dont_pattern: Serve only unoptimized JPEG or PNG

rule: Split bundles by route for faster initial load
do_pattern: Use dynamic imports for route-based code splitting

dont_code: import Page from './Page'; /* all in main bundle */

rule: Use dynamic imports for heavy components
do_pattern: Load components only when needed
dont_pattern: Import everything at the top level eagerly

rule: Enable tree shaking by using ES module imports
do_pattern: Import only the specific functions needed
dont_pattern: Import entire libraries bloating the bundle

rule: Minify production JavaScript and CSS
do_pattern: Use a build tool to minify assets
dont_pattern: Ship unminified code to production
dont_code: // no minification configured in production build

rule: Enable gzip or Brotli compression on the server
do_pattern: Configure server to compress text responses
do_code: // nginx: gzip on; gzip_types text/html application/javascript;
dont_pattern: Serve uncompressed assets over the network

rule: Set proper cache headers for static assets
do_pattern: Use long max-age with hashed filenames
dont_pattern: Use no-cache on all static assets

rule: Serve static assets through a CDN
do_pattern: Configure CDN origin for static files
dont_pattern: Serve all assets from a single origin server

rule: Preload critical assets like fonts and hero images
do_pattern: Use link rel=preload for critical resources
dont_pattern: Let critical resources be discovered late in the waterfall
dont_code: <!-- font discovered only when CSS is parsed -->

rule: Defer non-critical JavaScript
do_pattern: Use defer or async attributes on non-essential scripts
dont_pattern: Load all scripts synchronously blocking rendering

rule: Eliminate render-blocking CSS where possible
do_pattern: Inline critical CSS and load the rest asynchronously
do_code: <style>/* critical CSS inlined */</style><link rel="preload" href="styles.css" as="style" />

rule: Optimize web font loading to avoid FOIT

dont_pattern: Block text rendering until custom font loads

rule: Keep DOM size under 1500 nodes where possible
do_pattern: Virtualize long lists and simplify markup
dont_pattern: Render thousands of DOM nodes at once

rule: Debounce or throttle expensive event handlers
do_pattern: Debounce search input to limit API calls
dont_pattern: Fire API calls on every keystroke

rule: Use virtual scrolling for large data sets
do_pattern: Render only visible rows in long lists
do_code: import { FixedSizeList } from 'react-window'; <FixedSizeList height={600} itemCount={10000} itemSize={35}>{Row}</FixedSizeList>
dont_pattern: Render all 10000 rows into the DOM

rule: Register service workers for offline caching
do_pattern: Cache critical assets with a service worker
dont_pattern: Provide no offline support or caching strategy

rule: Use resource hints like prefetch and preconnect
do_pattern: Preconnect to required third-party origins
dont_pattern: Make cold connections to third-party origins on demand

rule: Optimize for Lighthouse performance score
do_pattern: Set performance budgets and audit regularly
